speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
text: asked the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (a) how many mental well-being circles under the SG Mental Well-Being Network have been formed so far; (b) how many members have been recruited and trained; and (c) what are some of the lessons learnt from forming well-being circles in the community.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: I just want to ask: I have seen the good work that MCCY has done through the Mental Well-Being Circles and I am actually quite encouraged and I hope that we can push more forward in a shorter time.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: One of the questions that I want to ask, is about how we can prepare them further when a pandemic comes again because we are currently debating this Motion where we talk about COVID-19.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: But when a pandemic strikes, we want to make sure that these Well-Being Circles can transform and become an emergency preparedness approach.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: Are there plans to go into that direction?

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: So, I would like to thank the Member for his contributions and also his strong support in his Kolam Ayer Well-Being Circle and I encourage him and other Members to continue to give us feedback on how to improve this as we go along.
